profile.headline: Senior SWE at Microsoft | Entrepreneur & Founder | Using Technology to Drive Social Change in Mexico
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft focused on building scalable diagnostics, telemetry, and developer tools across Azure. I enjoy collaborating across teams to deliver impactful solutions that improve how engineers monitor and operate systems. Passionate about technology, lifelong learning, and creating community‑driven projects.

positions.title: Senior software engineer
positions.description:
Led projects and architected solutions in close collaboration with cross-functional teams throughout the company, ensuring effective delivery of diagnostics and solutions within internal services and the Azure ecosystem.
Collaborated with the Azure Compute team to launch a new feature for RunCommand.
Developed and released a new third-party offering, enabling customers to collect diagnostics directly from issues identified by Azure Monitor Investigator.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked in a team delivering timely insights by integrating telemetry into developer workflows. Led a project to inform customers directly within the IDE about missing or misconfigured monitors and alerts, helping them efficiently track and instrument their services.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Part of a team delivering insights by integrating telemetry into developer workflows. Owned and maintained VS/VSCode extensions, App Services, and supporting infrastructure to provide insights to customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working in a team which focuses on delivering Insights by integrating Telemetry and bring it into the developer workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Collaborated on Robotic Process Automation for Software Validation. Enhanced an internal Windows app enabling automated robotic testing on customers' PCs via device-hosted virtual machines, resulting in over 100,000 additional testing hours each month.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked collaboratively on Robotic Process Automation for software validation. Developed an internal Windows application that enabled users to create cloud-based virtual machines mirroring those used in our lab, deploy necessary packages for automated testing, and allow customers to run their own tests on demand using their cloud resources.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Created an insight feature enabling customers to access TraceLogging data in their IDEs, including volume, throttling, privacy bugs, and diagnostic collection options.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed and implemented an internal website for recruiters, enabling users to efficiently identify engineers within the company who possess specific skills required for upcoming interviews.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a Windows application facilitating customers in cleaning, deploying, and executing MTBF tests on mobile devices.

courses.name: Data Science and Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Governance, and Laws
Participation in 2nd Hello Barcelona programming boot camp in collaboration with Moscow Workshops ACM ICPC

projects.title: ReciclaYa
projects.description: ReciclaYa is an artificial intelligence-driven platform designed to help microenterprises in Mexico identify recyclable packaging materials. Our goal is to make recycling more accessible and guide people to microenterprises towards sustainable practices.

projects.title: AidHub Connect
projects.description: AidHub Connect seeks to amplify the power of community and technology by crafting an intuitive digital bridge to connect those in need with the social programs and resources that can foster their educational, emotional, and economic growth.
